recipes.title: Japanese-Style Yogurt Soufflé Cake (Protein-Rich)

items.i: pinch of citric acid or a few drops of lemon juice

steps: Whip the egg whites with the lemon juice or citric acid to stiff peaks.
Mix the yolks, yogurt, rice flour, cornstarch and sweetener until smooth.
Gently fold in the whites with upward motions to keep it airy.
Pour into a lined tin and bake at 140°C (285°F) for exactly 1 hour in a water bath (bain-marie).
Let it cool completely before serving so the texture sets.
recipes.notes: Recipe is the creator's; she gives the macros per 100 g. The whole cake weighs roughly 600 g, so I've counted 6 slices of about 100 g.
